name: Shortcut Cheatsheet
description: macOS-style shortcut cheatsheet. Hold Super alone for ~0.8 s and an overlay lists useful shortcuts; let go and it disappears (and the Overview does not open). A quick Super tap still opens the Overview, and Super+<key> cancels the sheet and runs that shortcut. The list lives in ~/.config/shortcut-cheatsheet/shortcuts.json (created with defaults on first use, re-read every time the sheet is shown).
